The standalone checker evaluates 700 brute-force objectives plus Gaussian and polynomial identities; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The central invariant is the Euclidean spherical mean width of a standard, highly structured family of polytopes. The family exhibits an explicit C2-but-not-C3 transition at the same exact ratio where Gaussian-exposed support ranks switch from parameter-limited to sign-limited. The finite solid-angle orbit law supplies an independent geometric mechanism and yields a clipped-normal critical window, not a generic normalization or arbitrary parameter slice. This complete limiting profile is meaningful even without a more general theorem.
